name: Track 16
about_text: Track 16 is a Los Angeles gallery with two exhibition spaces, one in East Hollywood and one downtown in the historic Bendix Building. Sean Meredith serves as director. The program centers on a small roster of California-based and international artists working across painting, ceramics, sculpture, and installation, often engaging social and political themes—from feminist critiques of domestic craft (Elyse Pignolet) to politically charged painting (Sandow Birk, Robbie Conal) and reworked found ceramics (Debra Broz). The gallery also represents the estates of Pedro Álvarez and Simone Gad, and has shown Latin American collectives such as Mondongo. Track 16 participates in art fairs, publishes artist books under its Pinspot imprint, and has placed artists' work in institutions including LACMA, SFMOMA, and the Getty.

triage.site_notes: Track 16's site is organized around individual exhibition microsites (one URL per show, often with separate viewing-room/checklist/artwork-detail sub-pages) plus two roster pages (artists, artists-grid) and a formal exhibitions-archive covering only 1994-2016, so post-2016 shows must be identified via their individual exhibition pages rather than a consolidated archive; news is split across past-news and older-news, and no dedicated 'about/history' page was found in the inventory.
